description: Issue #830: re-adds [Public] (IAllowAnonymous) to the demo FileApiController's GetFile action -- a compile-preserving attribute add, not a statement delete -- reproducing the pre-fix state where any unauthenticated caller could read another tenant's FileAttachment content by GUID (WtmFileProvider.GetFile uses IgnoreQueryFilters() whenever FileUploadOptions.EnforceTenantFileScope is false, the default). Checked against FileApiControllerHardeningTests830.GetFile_Unauthenticated_RejectedAndDoesNotLeakContent_AuthenticatedSucceeds, which seeds a FileAttachment with a random marker string as its content and asserts both that an unauthenticated GET returns 401 AND that the response body never contains the marker -- not a status-code-only check, since a redirect or error page that happened to echo bytes back would also need to be caught. Only this GetFile action is mutated; the class's other actions (GetFileName, DownloadFile, etc.) are untouched by this specific patch, which is why the sibling DeletedFile-focused tests in the same class are used as the positive control below rather than every [Public] removal being re-verified by one shared mutant.
target_symbol: FileApiController.GetFile(WtmFileProvider,string,string,int?,int?) -- the [Public] attribute (absent after #830, this mutant re-adds it), line ~108

red_expected_assertion_patterns.WalkingTec.Mvvm.Api.Test.FileApiControll: #830: an unauthenticated caller must get 401 from GetFile \(the endpoint was \[Public\] before this fix\)\. Got 200\.
